home_hero.title: and Front-End Specialist
home_hero.desc: Passionate about crafting seamless user experiences through modern web technologies. I specialize in building intuitive, responsive, and visually appealing interfaces.

home_hero.desc_dos: I build websites that are not only visually appealing but also responsive and performance-driven. Every design choice is made with purpose, blending aesthetics with functionality to deliver impactful results.

items.title: Mobile Application Developer
details: Developed an application for passengers and drivers with navigation tailored to each user role.
Implemented geolocation, interactive maps, routes, stops, device permissions, and QR codes using React Native, Expo, TypeScript, Supabase, and React Native Maps.

items.title: Professional Internship
details: Developed a responsive website to promote seafood products, with intuitive navigation and a contact form integrated with Google Forms.
Implemented an inventory system with Python, Tkinter, and SQLite to manage products and transactions, generate reports, and automate backups.

items.title: Interface and Graphic Material Designer
details: Designed mockups, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity screens based on user needs and project requirements.
Created promotional graphic material to communicate the project's mission and value proposition.

items.title: Operational Internship
details: Created user manuals for security guard monitoring applications, structuring clear procedures for users.

items.title: Technical Internship
details: Supported the administration, classification, and organization of municipal documentation.

items.title: TEADORO
items.stack: ESP32-S3, FastAPI, WebSocket, and mobile application
details: Developed an interactive technology tool to support the practice of communication skills in children with Autism Spectrum Disorder at home and under adult supervision.

Contributed to requirements gathering, architecture design, hardware and software integration, and technical testing. The prototype achieved a 98.33% operational success rate and an average response time of 2.52 seconds.

items.title: Guided and Conscious Training in Artificial Intelligence
details: Trained and supported third-year Kinesiology students in the critical, guided, and responsible use of AI tools.
Collaborated on a quantitative quasi-experimental study with four levels of guidance, using surveys and rubrics.

items.title: Padel Court Booking System
details: Contributed to the development of a system with time-slot selection, user registration, and booking confirmation, integrated across three eighth-semester courses.

items.title: Sign Language Recognition
details: Implemented a sign language recognition prototype as the final project for the Artificial Intelligence course.
